verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Gitea supports PR-based code review with reviewer comments (gitea-docs-3, gitea-docs-12) and CI/CD via Gitea Actions (gitea-docs-2, gitea-docs-15) plus general permission/ACL security controls (gitea-docs-7), which are building blocks for merge gating, but there is no explicit documentation of branch protection rules, required status checks, or required-approval enforcement before merge. Missing for 10: explicit branch protection / required status check configuration, admin enforcement settings, and customization options for merge rules, plus independent confirmation these work as advertised.
